items.Sentence: The Discharger currently has an average daily discharge of 9,000 gpd, of domestic wastewater to a septic tank effluent pump (STEP) system for wastewater collection.
individual septic tanks with pump chambers and submersible pumps discharging to a dosing tank
discharging to a dosing tank and then to one or both of two common leachfields
subsurface disposal from individual septic tanks to two community leachfields
with a third leachfield proposed to be brought online in the near future
Phase ll ... purposes the installation of a recirculating sand filter (or equivalent) between the septic tanks and leachfields
Phase lll ... will involve the construction of an advanced secondary package treatment plant with sufficient effluent quality to be used as reclaimed water for possible golf course irrigation.
